entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I assist you today?
I need to make a return.
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number, please?
Sarah Jenkins. Order number is VF-881-92B.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on January 1st. To make sure I'm on the right page, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just not what I wanted. I already tried to return it once.
I see. My system shows the delivery was 21 days ago. Can you tell me when you first attempted the return?
A while ago. Your portal was broken. Some big `website error` message.
I understand the frustration. Let me check our system logs for any known issues. Were you trying around the 9th or 10th of the month?
I suppose. The whole `system down` issue was a real treat. Because of it, I `couldn't print` the label. I took a `screenshot` of the error, if that matters.

No need for the screenshot, Sarah, I believe you. I'm actually seeing a system-wide alert from that exact day regarding an outage on our returns portal. I sincerely apologize that you were impacted by that.
Let me just check our official return policy to get this sorted... Okay, according to our knowledge base here, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Right.
Since you're only on day 21, you are well within that window. I've gone ahead and processed the return authorization for you. A prepaid shipping label has just been sent to the email on file.
Fine. So I'll get a full refund?
Yes, absolutely. Once our warehouse receives the VeloBand, a full refund will be processed back to your original payment method. That usually takes 3-5 business days after it arrives.
Whatever. Thanks, I guess.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No.
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
